SQLite 3.54.1, SQLite authors and contributors.
The SQLite deliverable code is in the public domain.
Official statement: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html
Official amalgamation source: https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip
Exact archive/source hashes: third_party/sqlite.lock.json in AndroSwitch source.

AndroSwitch compiles the original amalgamation and provides its own memory VFS,
bounded API bridge and durable snapshot adapter (MIT OR Apache-2.0). This does
not imply Android's full SQLite connection pool, WAL or multiprocess behavior.
